text: Related requirements that the criteria below also address: ER-05.06 (remote diagnostics of the gas turbine with secure OEM access), ER-14.02 (emission limits), ER-14.03 (noise limit of 85 dB(A) at 1 m) and ER-15.03 (factory acceptance tests).
